## Hazards (read before any camera run)

| ID | Hazard | Effect | Rule | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="h01"></a>H01 | USB mode switch while a UVC overlay is active | Switching to PC Remote during an active UVC overlay rebooted the camera. | Stop and retire the session before any USB mode change. | [E0340](../evidence/0340-uvc-fixedbuffer-and-mode-switch-reboot.md) |
| <a id="h02"></a>H02 | Teardown without unconfigure-first | Device stayed 'unknown' in MSC after Track B sessions; battery pull needed and /tmp_bt receipts lost. | Use the unconfigure-first soft-disconnect (E0352/E0353) and copy receipts off before recovery. | [E0248](../evidence/0248-p4b-enumeration-teardown-failure.md), [E0255](../evidence/0255-f5b-ptp-handshake-failure-and-recovery.md), [E0350](../evidence/0350-trackb-transport-enumerates-but-renderstream-fails.md), [E0352](../evidence/0352-offline-teardown-soft-disconnect-fix.md) |
| <a id="h03"></a>H03 | Hooking live im.elf code | A hook without stop scope and four-core cache sync risks crashing PID 149. | Install hooks only inside a verified CPU barrier with four-core cache synchronization and restore the original instruction on retirement. | [E0192](../evidence/0192-retry-safe-native-cpu-barrier.md), [E0203](../evidence/0203-four-core-code-visibility-physically-verified.md), [E0205](../evidence/0205-physical-entry-hook-lifecycle-verified.md) |

## Entities

### <a id="usb-liveview-source"></a>Live-view JPEG source and DMM/ScalarInfra path

`usb.liveview-source` | process

The camera's live-view JPEG producer, DMM AllocRule/Rule 5, ScalarInfra SET_PATH and the shooting-state contract used as a UVC feed candidate.

Aliases: `GET_JPEG`, `SET_PATH`, `DMM Rule 5`

Current knowledge:

- **C01** `OFFLINE` USB live view comes from an original JPEG source with a width gate; DMM AllocRule Rule 5 activation and ScalarInfra SET_PATH start were verified, with the sensor still bounded in Mass Storage mode. ([E0132](../evidence/0132-usb-liveview-jpeg-source-and-width-gate.md), [E0144](../evidence/0144-native-jpeg-receiver-ownership-and-dma-allocation.md), [E0145](../evidence/0145-native-dma-metadata-and-single-jpeg-verified.md), [E0146](../evidence/0146-dmm-preflight-and-scalar-fsm-activation-contract.md), [E0147](../evidence/0147-dmm-allocrule-and-shooting-transition-contract.md), [E0148](../evidence/0148-dmm-rule5-unit-allocation-verified.md), [E0149](../evidence/0149-scalar-path-open-verified-and-msc-sensor-boundary.md))
- **C04** `PHYSICAL` In PC Remote, real sensor JPEG frames (1024x680) arrive over PTP; a foreign GET_JPEG sees live-view frames without starving the PTP stream, and the CinemaHUD PTP live-view demo works with confirmed PTP control. ([E0151](../evidence/0151-pc-remote-liveview-and-uvc-verified.md), [E0256](../evidence/0256-control-ptp-liveview-captured.md), [E0343](../evidence/0343-cinemahud-ptp-demo-verified.md), [E0349](../evidence/0349-p1-foreign-get-jpeg-succeeds-in-pc-remote.md))
- **C34** `OFFLINE` The UVC monitor architecture was set with a live read-only MSC snapshot, a safe DMA probe and a reference client. ([E0348](../evidence/0348-uvc-monitor-architecture-probe-and-reference-client.md))

### <a id="module-uvc-shared"></a>Shared UVC+PTP gadget module (usbg_video candidates)

`module.uvc-shared` | module | inventory `kernel.modules:usbg_stillimage`

Our composite UVC module built against the ZV-E10 reference stack, sharing the PTP/PC Remote gadget (usbg_stillimage) with gadgetcore dual-shadow registration.

Current knowledge:

- **C02** `OFFLINE` The ZV-E10 2.03 reference UVC stack (device node, gadget callback ABI, registration, quiescence, endpoint contract) was decoded and assembled into a composite kernel module with verified symbols. ### <a id="tool-native-hook"></a>Native entry hook, CPU barrier and MOD ioctl guard

`tool.native-hook` | tool

Native hook at 0x602b8844 with four-core cache sync, the retry-safe CPU barrier over PID 149 threads and the MOD atomic ioctl guard.

Aliases: `0x602b8844`, `mov ip,sp`

Current knowledge:

- **C05** `PHYSICAL` A native entry hook at 0x602b8844 was installed and retired with four-core cache coherence, restoring the original 'mov ip,sp'; the retry-safe CPU barrier and kernel thread membership checks were physically verified. ([E0192](../evidence/0192-retry-safe-native-cpu-barrier.md), [E0197](../evidence/0197-physical-native-stop-diagnostic-verified.md), [E0198](../evidence/0198-kernel-thread-membership-physically-verified.md), [E0203](../evidence/0203-four-core-code-visibility-physically-verified.md), [E0205](../evidence/0205-physical-entry-hook-lifecycle-verified.md))
- **C21** `PHYSICAL` The MOD atomic mode-change guard wraps the original ioctl; an already loaded VFS call and a read-only USB owner inventory were proved; the physical USB owner and service state were verified, owner CPU threads stopped and resumed within bounds, the real pullup path hardened, and the shared module's physical init/exit lifecycle verified with native reservation kept across the session. ([E0174](../evidence/0174-mod-native-mode-admission-gate-and-ioctl-slot.md), [E0175](../evidence/0175-mod-native-ioctl-wrapper-and-inflight-admission.md), [E0176](../evidence/0176-vfs-stale-call-proof-and-read-only-owner-inventory.md), [E0177](../evidence/0177-live-gadgetcore-owner-and-source-verified-control-state.md), [E0178](../evidence/0178-live-bounded-usb-owner-cpu-stop-resume.md), [E0179](../evidence/0179-native-pullup-target-and-teardown-boundaries.md), [E0180](../evidence/0180-native-self-reference-and-physical-module-lifecycle.md), [E0181](../evidence/0181-mod-native-ioctl-guard-and-shared-module-integration.md), [E0182](../evidence/0182-session-lifetime-native-exclusion-and-route-precondition.md))
- **C22** `PHYSICAL` Original ptrace ownership is inactive; the CPU barrier was refreshed with fresh owners, its kernel stop sites and stop reasons observed physically, module-native stop diagnostics added, and kernel-owned stop snapshots keep a synchronous scope; the integrated private-route lifetime cycle ran on the camera. ([E0183](../evidence/0183-original-ptrace-attach-and-inactive-contract.md), [E0193](../evidence/0193-fresh-owners-and-physical-cpu-barrier.md), [E0194](../evidence/0194-physical-kernel-ptrace-stop-sites.md), [E0195](../evidence/0195-physical-stop-signals-and-original-signal-entry.md), [E0196](../evidence/0196-module-native-stop-diagnostics.md), [E0199](../evidence/0199-kernel-owned-snapshots-and-synchronous-scope.md), [E0200](../evidence/0200-integrated-private-route-lifetime-cycle.md))

([E0184](../evidence/0184-original-dwc-pullup-drain-order.md), [E0185](../evidence/0185-dwc-event-worker-busy-producer.md), [E0186](../evidence/0186-original-gadget-setup-interface-dispatch.md), [E0187](../evidence/0187-original-request-retirement-and-completion.md), [E0188](../evidence/0188-ep0-disable-and-closed-admission.md), [E0189](../evidence/0189-public-ep0-queue-lock-and-admission.md), [E0190](../evidence/0190-route-lease-code-lifetime-policy.md), [E0191](../evidence/0191-route-held-recovery-and-partial-resume.md), [E0201](../evidence/0201-original-native-entry-bridge-and-cached-vfs-target.md), [E0202](../evidence/0202-original-smp-callback-completion.md), [E0204](../evidence/0204-entry-bridge-caller-drain-and-descriptor-flush.md))

### <a id="usb-ptp-pcremote"></a>PTP / PC Remote live view (054C:0CAA)

`usb.ptp-pcremote` | usb-identity | inventory `firmware.elf:nflasha15_unpacked/lib/libInfraRemote.so`

Stock PC Remote PTP session: live-view GetObject, the app dispatcher, InfraRemoteUsb queues and the s_LiveViewStatus gate.

Aliases: `GetObject 0xFFFFC002`, `SDIOConnect`, `s_LiveViewStatus`

Current knowledge:

- **C04** `PHYSICAL` In PC Remote, real sensor JPEG frames (1024x680) arrive over PTP; a foreign GET_JPEG sees live-view frames without starving the PTP stream, and the CinemaHUD PTP live-view demo works with confirmed PTP control. ([E0151](../evidence/0151-pc-remote-liveview-and-uvc-verified.md), [E0256](../evidence/0256-control-ptp-liveview-captured.md), [E0343](../evidence/0343-cinemahud-ptp-demo-verified.md), [E0349](../evidence/0349-p1-foreign-get-jpeg-succeeds-in-pc-remote.md))
- **C09** `PHYSICAL` Live-view start disconnects the composite device: the trigger is host WPD activity, not LCD live view; the stillimage gadget is recreated through a gadgetcore ioctl (setup_disconnect / usb_gcw_stop / start). ([E0277](../evidence/0277-liveview-start-disconnects-usb.md), [E0279](../evidence/0279-f9-0-gadgetcore-create-ioctl.md), [E0280](../evidence/0280-f9-0-kernel-symbols-setup-req-gcw.md), [E0284](../evidence/0284-f9-correction-wpd-trigger.md), [E0287](../evidence/0287-p3b-liveview-removes-device.md))

### <a id="proc-teardown"></a>Session teardown and return to Mass Storage

`proc.teardown` | process

Stopping the composite session and returning to stock Mass Storage (054C:0CA8) without a battery pull.

Aliases: `unconfigure-first`, `soft-disconnect`, `phases=0x1ff`

Current knowledge:

- **C08** `PHYSICAL` The original unconfigure ends in a no-op gadget ioctl and the module's direct pullup was the teardown suspect; an unconfigure-first session enumerates both children and returns to MSC cleanly, repeated 3/3. ([E0250](../evidence/0250-unconfigure-noop-and-pullup-suspect.md), [E0251](../evidence/0251-unconfigure-first-candidate-offline.md), [E0252](../evidence/0252-f4-unconfigure-first-clean-teardown.md), [E0254](../evidence/0254-f5a-repeated-clean-teardowns.md))
- **C14** `PHYSICAL` Run A: unconfigure-first soft-disconnect returns the camera to Mass Storage without a battery pull (teardown and daemon lifecycle only, no UVC frame). ([E0352](../evidence/0352-offline-teardown-soft-disconnect-fix.md), [E0353](../evidence/0353-run-a-teardown-success.md))

### <a id="ref-zve10-uvc"></a>ZV-E10 2.03 reference UVC stack

`ref.zve10-uvc` | module

The ZV-E10's usbg_video.ko, devno.ko nodes 248:32/33 and descriptors, used as the a6400 UVC source and overlay plan.

Current knowledge:
